description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) of various models across six different datasets—SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI—comparing the performance of MADLLM against three variants: MADLLM w/o feature embedding, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the datasets. For each dataset, four bars are displayed, corresponding to the four models, with colors indicating the specific model: green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, blue for MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and orange for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. In most datasets, MADLLM (green) achieves the highest F1 score, followed by MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange), then MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and finally MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), which consistently shows the lowest score. For example, on the PSM dataset, MADLLM achieves a score of approximately 97%, while MADLLM w/o prompt pool scores around 77%. On the WADI dataset, MADLLM scores approximately 74%, MADLLM w/o skip embedding scores around 68%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding scores about 61%, and MADLLM w/o prompt pool scores roughly 63%. The bars are grouped by dataset, and the legend below the chart clearly identifies each model with its corresponding color.
